title: TrpNRll 2.0  recent release, “Artist With The Glock,”  is a hip-hop masterpiece
htmlContent:
American Hip-Hop star TrpNRll 2.0 envelops his listeners in a warm bath of sunshine, and his vocals seamlessly melt into one another in his recent song “Artist With The Glock.” This multi-talented lyrical genius has taken all his time to learn and improve his craft.

TrpNRll 2.0’s “Artist With The Glock” is an intriguing display of talent that gives the culture something with unlimited replay value. His pen is top-tier, and his flow brings a heavy presence that makes him impossible to ignore on one of the dopest Hip Hop records you will hear from any part of the world.
